verdict.rationale: Notte's scraping docs show structured extraction driven by a Pydantic model (class HackerNewsFeed(BaseModel)). Fetch is documented as returning page content "as markdown or structured data using LLM-powered extraction," so typed output beyond raw text is a first-party capability. The docs excerpts do not show schema validation behavior or error handling, a Zod/TypeScript equivalent, or extraction tied to agent runs specifically, and one community user reported extraction failing on a specific site. Missing for 10: documented schema-validation and error semantics, a Zod/TypeScript typed-extraction path, explicit typed extraction from agent-visited pages, and independent hands-on corroboration of successful typed extraction.

support.subject: As a developer, I can extract typed, schema-validated data (Zod/Pydantic-style) from pages the agent visits, not just raw text
